instructions.content: NEVER add content outside `src/content/docs/`; Starlight routing only picks up files there
NEVER use `src` inside `logo` alongside `light`/`dark`; they are mutually exclusive
NEVER hard-code sidebar slugs with leading slashes or file extensions
NEVER set `site` inside `starlight({})` for sitemap; it belongs at the `defineConfig` level
NEVER mix `autogenerate` with `items` in the same sidebar group
NEVER put Starlight options in a separate config file; they live inside `starlight({})`
NEVER assume a page appears in the sidebar just because the file exists; sidebar and routing are independent unless `autogenerate` is used
NEVER hand-roll the integration when `npx astro add starlight` exists
NEVER publish a work-in-progress page without `draft: true`
NEVER use this skill for theming or component overrides; use `starlight-theme` or `starlight-custom-component`
Scaffold a new project with `npm create astro@latest -- --template starlight`
Start the dev server with `npm run dev`
Give every content page `title` and `description` frontmatter
